morphology.pattern_note: 英语人名，在马来语中作为完整专名使用，不作马来语词缀分析。IPA采用常见英式读音，实际读法以本人为准。

senses.zh_definition: 乔吉：英语人名，可为George或Georgia等名字的昵称；具体指称由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An English personal name, used as a diminutive of George or Georgia, among related names.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang dalam bahasa Inggeris, antaranya nama timangan bagi George atau Georgia; orang yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 实际书写应大写为Georgie。它是专有名词，不具有可直接译成普通马来语词义的含义；不能仅凭名字判断性别或认定某个人物。所列搭配为自然组合，不代表固定搭配或经语料统计确认的高频组合。status依指定格式保留为official，不表示DBP将其认证为马来语普通词；马来语释义为编辑释义。

dual_scenarios.ms: Georgie akan membentangkan laporan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 乔吉将在明天的会议上汇报项目情况。
dual_scenarios.en: Georgie will present the project report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Georgie dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Georgie sudah sampai di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Georgie arrived at the café yet?
spoken_features: 句末ke用于口语是非问句。

etymology.historical_story: Georgie belongs to an English naming tradition in which familiar forms express affection or closeness. It is used for names such as George and Georgia. The underlying George family ultimately connects with Greek words for farming and working the earth. That historical association explains the name's ancestry, rather than a person's occupation. [Sources: Georgie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/georgie), [George](https://www.behindthename.com/name/george).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把Georgie听成两拍的“乔—吉”，联想朋友喊人的昵称；整个人名记忆，不拆成马来语词根。
